{{Top|leg}}
The '''skrannix''' was a type of gray-colored feline quadruped, with a broad forehead and a tail that had a stinger at the end. At some point during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], a [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] set out to transport a cargo of skrannix to the [[Bollin Exotic Animal Emporium]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]], and stopped en route at the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Nub Saar]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Genarius]]. However, Nub Saar was hit by a [[Radiation/Legends|radiation]] storm, which mutated the skrannix and made them more aggressive. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Heroes of Cularin]] traveled to Nub Saar, and they encountered a group of the mutated skrannix.
